items.computation: Invoice date is 21.11.2026 (a Saturday). Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the triggering event (the invoice date) is not counted; the 21-day period begins the next day, 22.11.2026 (day 1). Counting 21 days forward (§188 Abs.1 BGB), day 21 falls on 12.12.2026. 12.12.2026 is a Saturday. This is a private payment obligation to a company; under §193 BGB, when the last day of a period for a payment falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period ends on the next working day. The next working day after Saturday 12.12.2026 is Monday 14.12.2026 (no public holiday intervenes in NW).
